summary: Monday's close extended a sharp rotation out of mega-cap tech, with QQQ trailing defensive staples by roughly 14 points as long Treasuries rallied hard and credit spreads stayed stressed. Equity volatility held above its recent average, keeping stocks in fear while a modest bounce lifted gold and crypto stayed pinned near its recent lows.
tweet: Tech keeps bleeding into bonds and staples Monday as credit stress and above-average volatility hold stocks in fear.
